spawn.method: chunk-based random roll with region spacing (e.g. one candidate per 48x48-chunk region... tune), persisted so a portal is generated once
spawn.rarity: target roughly 1 P1-1 portal per ~1500x1500 blocks of land (config)
spawn.valid_biomes: any land biome; exclude ocean, deep ocean, river, void, mushroom islands (config list)
spawn.placement_height: portal bottom = surface Y + 0.5 (float); never underground; if clearance fails shift +/-8 blocks up to 3 times then abort roll

orientation.yaw: random multiple of 45 degrees chosen at creation, stored
orientation.safe_entry: keep a 5x5 area in front of and behind the plane free of blocks at feet/head height; no block placement protection needed beyond that clear zone

no_structure: Do NOT generate any blocks around the portal (no frame, supports, stones). Optional: faint ground decals only via ground_projection texture.
overlap_protection: reject candidates whose 24x24 footprint intersects any structure bounding box (use structure manager) or another portal footprint

persistent_identity.notes: Portal remains after completion (or per design), re-entry rules by integration developer.

return_location.record_on_entry: dimension, exact feet position, yaw, game mode
return_location.safe_return: on exit place player 2 blocks in front of the portal plane on the side they entered; verify solid floor + 2 air blocks; else spiral search radius 6, then scan upward; last resort world spawn
